MIX-1 is reported as a named per-ell table.

G9 EVERYTHING CHARGED: the four-way component split is reported per cell; memory is reported beside time for every cell; the per-entry cost is reported BOTH amortised and fully charged for Phi retrieval, WITH BOTH FITS.

G10 THE EXTRAPOLATION WAS COMPUTED BY SUBSTITUTION INTO THE COMMITTED UNMODIFIED EXP-P13VOW-001 MODEL with its SHA-256 recorded; c_star was SOLVED by that model with its tolerance recorded; NO MARGIN ARITHMETIC WAS DONE BY HAND; and EVERY MARGIN FIGURE IS LABELLED EXTRAPOLATION WITH EA-1..EA-6 ATTACHED IN THE SAME STRUCTURE.

G11 THE PRE-REGISTERED READING WAS EVALUATED MECHANICALLY with every contributing gate named, READING-NOT-IDENTIFIED given precedence where it applies, and NO INTERPRETATION, DISPOSITION, RECOMMENDATION OR HYPOTHESIS-STATUS OPINION WRITTEN.

G12 SCOPE HELD: nothing written outside experiments/EXP-SSI-002/; specification.yaml and derivation_note.md UNMODIFIED; nothing under experiments/EXP-ISO-001/ touched; no commit made; no AppleDouble sidecar.

G13 BUDGET DISCIPLINE: pre-flight disk figure recorded before the first write; every cap observed; every breach recorded as infrastructure signal with its terminal status and never fed to a reading; downsampling bookkeeping recorded and no truncated JSON written.

constraints: SAGE IS INVOKED THROUGH THE BINARY /usr/local/bin/sage AND NEVER AS A PYTHON IMPORT. `import sage` FROM SYSTEM python3 FAILS ON THIS HOST. CAPTURE `sage --version` VERBATIM INTO runs/RUN-SSI-002/sage_version.txt BEFORE THE FIRST COMPUTATION. A version other than 10.9 is RECORDED, not corrected. Any artifact showing a bare python3 invocation of Sage code is a defect of that artifact.

THE SWEEP IS MANDATORY AND A SINGLE-p MEASUREMENT IS NOT AN ACCEPTABLE SUBSTITUTE FOR ANY REASON, INCLUDING BUDGET. AN EXPONENT CANNOT BE IDENTIFIED FROM ONE PRIME. If the budget forces a reduced sweep, RECORD WHICH PRIMES WERE NOT REACHED BY NAME and report NO FITTED EXPONENT if fewer than 6 admissible primes remain.

EVERY PRIME IS COMPUTED IN-SESSION BY THE CONTRACT'S RULE - the largest prime below 2^k congruent to 3 mod 4 - AND NONE IS HARDCODED, TRANSCRIBED OR PASSED ON THE COMMAND LINE. Record each p, the candidates rejected, and the E0.is_supersingular() result. A False supersingularity result stops that prime and is an environment defect, never a mathematical finding.

REPORT NO c WITHOUT ITS INTERVAL, ITS FULL SIGNED RESIDUALS AND ITS GOODNESS-OF-FIT VERDICT IN THE SAME STRUCTURE. A BARE c IS A DEFECT OF THIS CARD. Compute BOTH the t-interval and the 2000-resample bootstrap interval and CARRY THE WIDER ONE; selecting the narrower for a headline is forbidden.

GAP-1: ALGORITHM 1 AS PUBLISHED NEVER SEEDS THE LIST AND CANNOT BE RUN. USE SEED-A (L initialised to the single identity entry) AS PRIMARY FOR EVERY FIT, RUN SEED-B AT k = 20 AND k = 40 AT B-FIX-8 UNDER V-1, NAME THE STRATEGY IN EVERY CELL RECORD, CHARGE AND REPORT seed_seconds, AND REPORT THE SEED-A/SEED-B PER-ENTRY RATIO AND THE SEED-GATE VERDICT. DO NOT INVENT A THIRD STRATEGY. DO NOT DESCRIBE THE SEEDING AS A REPAIR OF THE PAPER - GAP-1 STAYS OPEN.

CHARGE EVERYTHING. The timed window covers Phi_ell evaluation, ROOT FINDING, the non-backtracking filter and the table insertion, and EACH OF THE FOUR IS ALSO REPORTED SEPARATELY. Report memory beside time for every cell. EXCLUDE SAGE STARTUP FROM EVERY TIMED WINDOW and record it separately as sage_startup_seconds. Report the per-entry cost BOTH with Phi retrieval amortised (primary) AND fully charged, WITH BOTH FITS.

RUN ALL FIVE CONTROLS AND REPORT EVERY GATE VERDICT: CTRL-CAL (F_{p^2} mul/inv and an empty loop, at every prime, INTERLEAVED not blocked, with their own fits), CTRL-NULL (fixed-buffer SHA-256 and fixed-key dict ops, with their own fits), CTRL-DRIFT (start/end re-measurement at the extreme primes, ROUND-ROBIN cell ordering, wall and CPU time recorded separately), CTRL-COUNT (realised #L against the Lemma 3.2 upper and Section 4.1 lower bounds, plus 50 ell-isogeny spot checks per cell), CTRL-DET (determinism re-execution of two named cells against entry counts, table sizes and j-invariant SETS).

IF CTRL-NULL-GATE OR CTRL-CAL-GATE FIRES, NO c IS CARRIED INTO THE EXTRAPOLATION AND THE PRIMARY FIT IS REPORTED NOT-INTERPRETABLE. Report the measured costs anyway. DO NOT SUPPRESS A CONTROL FAILURE AND DO NOT RERUN UNTIL IT PASSES - maximum_runs is 1.

THE EXTRAPOLATION IS COMPUTED BY SUBSTITUTION INTO THE COMMITTED UNMODIFIED EXP-P13VOW-001 COST MODEL, AND c_star IS SOLVED NUMERICALLY BY THAT SAME MODEL. NO MARGIN ARITHMETIC IS PERFORMED BY HAND ANYWHERE IN THIS CARD. Record the model's file SHA-256 and the solve tolerance. LABEL EVERY MARGIN FIGURE `EXTRAPOLATION` AND ATTACH EA-1..EA-6 TO IT IN THE SAME STRUCTURE.

p ~ 2^40 IS NOT CRYPTOGRAPHIC SIZE. NO ARTIFACT OF THIS CARD MAY STATE OR IMPLY THAT THE NIST-I MARGIN HAS BEEN MEASURED. Every NIST-I, NIST-III and NIST-V figure is an extrapolation conditional on the fitted c holding out to log2 p = 256, and EA-3 - that the measured B regime never reaches the operating B - MUST APPEAR BESIDE EVERY SUCH FIGURE AND NOT ONLY IN A LIMITATIONS LIST.

EVALUATE THE PRE-REGISTERED READINGS MECHANICALLY BY THE RULES FROZEN IN EXP-SSI-002 AND INTERPRET THEM NOT AT ALL. Record which of READING-SMALL-C, READING-LARGE-C, READING-STRADDLE, READING-NOT-IDENTIFIED, READING-INFRASTRUCTURE fired, WITH EVERY CONTRIBUTING GATE RESULT NAMED. READING-NOT-IDENTIFIED TAKES PRECEDENCE OVER THE THREE MARGIN READINGS. WRITE NO INTERPRETATION, NO DISPOSITION, NO RECOMMENDATION AND NO HYPOTHESIS-STATUS OPINION - those belong to the reviews and to the Coordinator at TASK-20260731-005.

DO NOT MODIFY experiments/EXP-SSI-002/specification.yaml OR derivation_note.md. THEY ARE FROZEN, THEY ARE COMMITTED BEFORE YOU RUN, AND THEY ARE THE PRE-REGISTRATION THAT MAKES THIS CARD WORTH ANYTHING. DO NOT READ, EDIT, STAGE OR SUPERSEDE ANYTHING UNDER experiments/EXP-ISO-001/. IT BELONGS TO AN UNRELATED LINE OF WORK (INT-BATCH002-A).

WRITE NOTHING OUTSIDE experiments/EXP-SSI-002/. Nothing under ledger/, knowledge/, harness/, tools/, inputs/, or any other experiment directory. NEVER touch tools/validate_ledger_baseline.txt. Write no macOS AppleDouble sidecar file.
MAKE NO COMMIT. This card writes files; TASK-20260731-002 commits them and nothing else does.
RUN THE PRE-FLIGHT DISK CHECK BEFORE THE FIRST WRITE and record the exact free-space figure in manifest.yaml. IF FREE SPACE IS BELOW 5 GiB, STOP AND REPORT AND WRITE NO RUN ARTIFACTS.

OBSERVE THE CAPS: 120 s per cell, 600 s per prime, 300 s for the calibration control, 180 s for the null controls, 360 s for drift and determinism, 300 s for the fit, 5400 s TOTAL, 4 GB memory, 8 MiB per file and 32 MiB for the run directory. A BREACH TERMINATES THAT UNIT AND IS RECORDED AS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL WITH ITS TERMINAL STATUS - NEVER AS A MEASUREMENT, NEVER AS A NEGATIVE RESULT AND NEVER FED TO ANY READING. On a total breach, STOP AND REPORT A BOUNDED PARTIAL RESULT NAMING EXACTLY WHICH CELLS WERE NOT REACHED.

APPLY THE PRE-REGISTERED DOWNSAMPLING RULE TO RAW PER-ENTRY TIMINGS ONLY, RECORDING k AND THE PRE-DOWNSAMPLING COUNT; COMPUTE ALL SUMMARY STATISTICS ON THE FULL UNDOWNSAMPLED DATA; AND NEVER WRITE A TRUNCATED JSON DOCUMENT.
WRITE ALL THIRTEEN DECLARED FILES EVEN FOR A PARTIAL, CANCELLED OR FAILED CARD, with the terminal status recorded in manifest.yaml. That is what makes the fourteen-path archive declaration exact.
